description: Reads what each agent that works on this business needs from the owner, as each agent's card on Agents lists it: for each agent, what Marsell already has (its value and where it came from) and what it still needs, each with its key, what it is, why the agent needs it, whether the agent can work without it, how to give it: need_set with that key and the kind of value it takes, or where in Marsell the owner gives it themselves (an account to connect, a password or key, anything that spends), and its hint and note, which say when giving it leads an agent to paid work. Anything to copy comes as its text, such as a sign-up form's HTML for the owner's own site, with the page to open where there is one. A private one (the applicant's own details) says only that it is on file. Reading spends nothing.

agent.description: one agent's needs, by its id (agents_read gives the ids); every agent's when left out

missing.description: true: only what Marsell does not have yet

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: needs_read
title: Read what the agents need
